notes: The shell's frame (#902, #967): the chrome the page draws around a screen, measured against the shell's own at 393. It is a pair of states, because the page has two chromes and a screen must not drift from one into the other. `at-rest` is the primary frame - the top bar `Navbar` draws and the bottom bar `BottomTabBar` draws - recorded on `/`, the one every member can reach with no session; `origin` is the top bar because the two clients' windows are not the same height: the design is the bars' own boxes and the gap the frame leaves between them, not where the frame starts. `secondary` is the drill-down frame - no bar, no title, the floating back control `SecondaryHeader` draws and the band `#main-content` reserves - recorded on `/account/faq`, a real secondary page. There is no `capture`: the page's bars are glass over the page's content, and the account tab has the member's avatar floated over it, so a raster of the frame is a raster of the hero and of the session - the gate entry's `why` says why the frame is contract-only. Colours - the active tab's violet, the bar's tint - are not measured for the same reason: they are composited against content the app does not draw. The services sheet is a state of its own (it opens over the frame), not the frame at rest; the home surface's `picker` state measures it.

motion.notes: The fixed top bar slides away and returns and settles between 64px and 80px as the page scrolls, over 300ms with the site cubic-bezier; tabs and their icons scale to 1.05 on hover or selection. The same means the same travel, height and 200-300ms easing, with reduced motion removing the transition.

entries.gesture: scroll down, then scroll back up
entries.moves: the fixed top bar slides away and returns, settling between 64px and 80px tall over 300ms with the site cubic-bezier
entries.same: the same travel, settled height and 300ms easing; reduced motion removes the transition and leaves the bar at rest

entries.gesture: hover over or keyboard-focus a tab
entries.moves: the tab and its icon scale to 1.05 over 200-300ms
entries.same: the same 1.05 scale and 200-300ms easing; reduced motion removes the scale and keeps the selected state
